answer: Clone farming dies when uniqueness is prepaid and checked on the wire. Before an address can vote or grade, it must lock 150 POA in a four-epoch vault that only unlocks after three later answers are sealed. Every text is folded into a canonical 5-gram sketch; Jaccard overlap above 0.82 in one window slashes 80 percent of the later bond and merges both wallets into a single vote. Under a willow by the lock, a copied paragraph is an open signal, and a flock of sparrow paraphrases counts as one attacker rather than a chorus of independent seats.
